data.job_description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

Position: Manager – GL Close/FP&A/Investment Accounting/Reg Reporting/Financial Accounting

Experience: 10+ Years

Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Manager with 8-10 years of progressive accounting and financial planning experience to lead financial operations and financial transformation projects. The successful candidate will oversee general ledger close processes, month-end accounting operations, investment accounting, and financial planning activities. The Manager will lead finance transformation initiatives focused on General Ledger (GL) Close, FP&A, and Record to Report operations within Financial Services firms. This role requires a strategic manager with extensive process expertise and proficiency in technology platforms (e.g., Oracle, Workday, Adaptive, PowerApps) to drive significant value. The Manager will leverage process improvement methodologies and technology as enablers to achieve operational efficiency and enhance accuracy through best-in-class processes and tools.

Key Responsibilities:

• Chart of Accounts Mapping & Redesign: Design, implement, optimize Chart of Accounts structures that align with reporting requirements. Lead CoA mapping during ERP implementations, ensuring seamless data translation. Develop dimensional hierarchies and account coding standards to support multi-entity consolidation and reporting.
• Management of GL Close Activities: Lead and manage the complete GL close and month-end accounting cycles, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant financial statement preparation. Review journal entries, reconciliation procedures and account analyses to ensure financial statement integrity. Coordinate inter-company eliminations, consolidation adjustments and balance sheet reconciliations.
• Investment Accounting Operations Oversee investment accounting operations, including security transactions, valuations, reconciliations, and reporting. Prepare investment performance reports, reconcile investment holdings and manage regulatory compliance for investment portfolios.
• Transformation Initiatives: Support strategic finance transformation programs, including ERP implementations, system migrations, and digital process redesign.
• Comprehensive As-Is Assessments: Conduct detailed assessments of current Finance processes, including planning, budgeting, reporting, and finance close, utilize process mapping and modelling tools viz. Visio, ARIS and identify areas for improvement.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including IT, Tax, Treasury, and Operations, to drive integrated finance transformation and foster a culture of continuous improvement.
• Technology Transformation: Establish automated close processes and eliminate legacy systems through process redesign. Implement advanced accounting platforms viz. Workday, Workiva, Blackline, Tagetik, Trintech and spearhead finance transformation initiatives.

Key Skills:

• GL Close: General Ledger Management, Chart of Accounts Design and Month end close processes
• Investment Accounting: Strong experience in Investment Accounting, NAV calculations and securities management with valuation expertise
• Deep Understanding of FP&A Processes: Extensive knowledge of FP&A processes, including forecasting, budgeting, finance close, intercompany accounting, financial reporting standards, and management reporting.
• Finance Transformation: Proven experience in conducting As-Is and To-Be process assessments, process redesign and continuous improvement methodologies.
• Finance Systems Proficiency: Significant experience with Finance Systems such as Oracle EPM, Anaplan, Adaptive, Workiva, Workday, Blackline, Trintech, Tagetik and designing operating models that integrate people, processes, and technology.
• Stakeholder Engagement: Demonstrated experience in stakeholder engagement, facilitating workshops, and translating complex business needs into actionable solutions.

Education:

• Domain Expertise: Strong exposure to working in the Financial Services domain across Banking, Insurance, Asset Management, and Capital Markets.
• Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or Business Administration. Advanced degrees (MBA or equivalent) are preferred. B.Tech or Engineering graduates with relevant work experience in finance or financial systems.

Experience Requirements:

• Extensive Experience: 10+ years of experience in finance operations, accounting, or transformation roles.
• Proven Track Record: A successful history of driving finance process improvements, optimizing close cycles, implementing automation, and ensuring compliance in GL Close, FP&A, and R2R functions.

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Excellent multi-tasking skills

CA, CMA, ACCA

Finance Controller

Customer, Contract & Deal Financial Analysis

Job Summary
The Sr. Analyst, Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) plays an important role in the GRC delivery framework, ensuring Black & Veatch’s compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements, assessing control design and operation against common standards and frameworks, and assisting with third-party/supply chain risk management. The candidate will also promote a culture of risk awareness across the enterprise among other responsibilities. With an emphasis on cyber, contract and regulatory compliance risk management, the ideal candidate should be able to contribute to measuring success and identifying improvement opportunities and capabilities development in these areas.

This role is ideal for a detail-oriented professional with a passion for cyber and compliance risk management who is comfortable operating independently and not strictly by run books and procedures. Independent and critical thinking is absolutely necessary to be successful in this role as is a desire to drive efficiencies in function delivery and day-to-day tasks.

Key Responsibilities
Contract Risk Management

• Proven experience assessing client contract provisions related to data security, breach reporting, right to audit, security practice, and certification requirements
• Understanding of cyber resilience requirements across geographies and market sectors and industries

Regulatory Compliance Risk Management

• Request and review documentation and evidence from control owners to certify and validate compliance to regulatory requirements and best practice
• Monitor regulatory and legal landscape at a global scale and maintain awareness of compliance requirements
• Support independent certification and audit by working with D&IT peer groups and lines of business to collect documentation and evidence

IT Governance

• Act as an informed voice in development of policy and ensure alignment with regulatory, legal, and contractual requirements
• Assist establishment and enforcement of standards of practice documentation to be referenced by architecture and operations teams
• Contribute process and subject matter expertise in governance forums and cross-functional committees

Supplier/Third Party Risk Management

• Contribute subject matter expertise through third party risk assessment process
• Identify and communicate risk of vendor engagements and mitigation actions to business owners and D&IT stakeholders
• Assist review of client security requirements in contracts and aggregate relevant clauses to inform contractual risk

Cyber Risk Management

• Support establishment, collection, and ongoing improvement of metrics to measure effectiveness of cyber risk management and provide data-driven insight to decision makers and control owners
• Collaborate with peer D&IT groups to collect KPI’s, KRI’s and drive efficiency through automation and other means

Miscellaneous:

• Assist development of user training aligned with cyber threat landscape, establish and implement metrics, and propose enhancements
• Support internal audit
• Assist with security certification/attestations/audits to demonstrate control effectiveness to independent service auditors/assessors and C3PAO’s
• Assist in development of mitigation plans and monitoring progress of actions.
• Collaborate with members of the GRC team to ensure timely and quality deliverables to internal and external customers
• Contribute subject matter expertise in review and response to internal and external sourced GRC related requests

Management Responsibilities

Preferred Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Information Security, or a related field
• 7–10 years of experience in GRC executing or auditing against standards, frameworks, and industry regulations
• Demonstrated experience supporting GRC functions for US-based global companies
• Strong desire to create task and functional efficiencies through use of technology and tools, especially GenAI
• Proven ability to assess alignment of internal policy, process, control design and operations, and cyber risk management with regulatory standards and frameworks
• Strong collaboration with IT teams
• Familiarity with industry standards and frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27001, AICPA SOC)
• Solid understanding of information security principles and concepts

Preferred Qualifications

• Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills

Role: Director of Finance & Compliance Pune
Experience: 8-10 years
Salary: Up to 20-24 LPA

About the role:

The Director of Finance & Compliance is a critical leadership position accountable for overseeing the organizations entire financial ecosystem. This individual will ensure the integrity of financial operations guarantee absolute statutory compliance lead strategic financial reporting and serve as the primary liaison between internal leadership and external stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Operations & Strategic Accounting (25%)
• Team Oversight: Lead the finance team in managing day-to-day accounting including journal entries reconciliations and general ledger integrity.
• Process Leadership: Ensure accurate processing of payroll vendor payments and statutory deductions (TDS PF ESI).
• Financial Closures: Supervise month-end and year-end closures ensuring high-quality preparation of financial statements.
• Budgeting & Grants: Set processes for budget projections fund utilization tracking and complex grant-related accounting for donor requirements.
• Banking: Maintain governance over bank accounts manage payment controls and lead banking partner relationships.

2. Compliance Governance & Audit Management (25%)
• Statutory Excellence: Ensure full compliance with Income Tax GST TDS PF and other applicable laws.
• Reporting: Oversee the preparation and timely filing of all routine statutory returns.
• Audit Leadership: Manage relationships with statutory donor and internal auditors; ensure smooth and timely audit closures.
• Donor Compliance: Oversee the end-to-end donor lifecycle including grant onboarding utilization certificates (UCs) and specialized reporting.

3. Financial Analysis & Stakeholder Management (30%)
• Systems Design: Implement comprehensive tracking systems for donor and project-specific finances to ensure transparency for all stakeholders.
• Strategic Insights: Develop monthly MIS reports financial dashboards and cash-flow forecasts to support Board-level decision-making.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Vertical Heads to manage financial projections and optimize risk management across the organization.
• External Liaison: Serve as the primary point of contact for banks auditors vendors and regulatory bodies.
• Board Engagement: Prepare quarterly reports and provide strategic recommendations to the Finance Subcommittee and the Board.

4. Team Leadership & Process Innovation (20%)
• Mentorship: Recruit manage and mentor the finance team fostering a culture of ownership and continuous capacity building.
• Control Strengthening: Continuously improve internal controls and workflows to increase efficiency and reduce operational risks.
• Documentation Standards: Drive high standards for record-keeping and organizational transparency.

Requirements

Education & Experience
• Qualifications: Chartered Accountant (CA) or MBA in Finance with a proven leadership track record.
• Professional Background: 810 years of experience with significant expertise in managing financial operations for mid-sized organizations.
• Sector Knowledge: Strong preference for candidates with experience in Non-Profits and FCRA compliance .
• Communication: Demonstrated ability to present complex financial data to Board members and senior stakeholders.
• Technical Mastery: Advanced proficiency in Excel and financial modeling (creating dashboards and scenario planning tools).
• Communication: Exceptional written and oral English; functional knowledge of the regional language is preferred.

data.job_title: Chartered Accountant - Transfer Pricing - Consulting Firm
data.job_description:
As a Manager in the SBU Transfer Pricing team, your role will involve working on engagements and teams of varying sizes depending on the client/project. To qualify for this position, you should meet the following requirements:

- Be a Qualified Chartered Accountant with 2-8 years of relevant experience
- Demonstrate innovative and critical thinking in managing projects
- Possess excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Have strong analytical and numerical skills
- Exhibit well-rounded commercial and economic awareness, understanding of financial markets, and a passion for client servicing
- Show proficiency in number crunching, have an excellent eye for detail, and be efficient in MS Office and report writing
- Be motivated, creative, and decisive in problem-solving
- Take ownership and responsibility of clients/tasks delegated

Your responsibilities as a Manager will include:

- Reviewing and finalizing transfer pricing documentation reports
- Identifying international transactions, computing arm's length prices, selecting appropriate methods, and preparing transfer pricing study reports
- Completing transfer pricing assignments including benchmarking studies for multinational clients
- Managing a team of Associates and Interns working on specific clients within the industry
- Assisting clients in transfer pricing planning
- Expanding opportunities with existing clients and acting on referrals related to the Service Line
- Conducting economic and comparability analyses using Indian and foreign databases
- Preparing and reviewing technical submissions for assessments and appellate levels
- Strategizing and representing the client's case before Tax Officers/Appellate levels
- Taking complete ownership of assigned engagements
- Coordinating with other Managers/Associate Directors for assignment planning and management
- Providing high-quality services and work products that exceed client expectations
- Managing client relationships
- Developing strong working relationships with colleagues across service lines and PwC locations

Expertise in Transfer Pricing, a good knowledge of OECD TP Guidelines, and familiarity with transfer pricing regulations of developed countries are essential for this role.
